content.dataset: Complete daily synthetic equity-flow cohort documents

enumeration_contract.complete_set: Exactly the cohort item for each declared period_date whose period_end <= current synthetic time within the requested inclusive date window.
enumeration_contract.completeness: Compare listing to the deterministic period/end rule; no omitted eligible item. COMPLETE requires successful full listing; failure/partial result establishes no absence.
enumeration_contract.item_identity: cohort-YYYY-MM-DD, one FIRST_RELEASE document per period; differing bytes at same locator remain a new Observation, never replacement.
enumeration_contract.window: One UTC daily period per retrieval; bounded to 2026-10-28 through 2027-04-29.

content.extraction_rule: From rows count n_large and k_large using spike=true and size_units>=2; n_large=0 or malformed bytes => NOT_EXTRACTABLE; otherwise return the pair (k_large,n_large), tied to the DOCUMENT sequence.
content.field_definition: For the declared daily cohort, selling=true spike rows with size_units>=2 divided by all spike rows with size_units>=2.
content.parsing: Strict JSON under host_and_protocol canonical rules, with schema exactly formation_cohort; unique event_id and exact period/item binding.
content.provider: Local deterministic source fixture from this packet; not a model vendor
content.structural_availability_bound: Declared local source releases the period document no earlier than period_end; a bound within the simulated source contract only, never proof of real-market availability or forward credit.
